desc: Hooks never change claims, their places or outputs; they write only git-ignored local files under .claims/local/ (session state, the activity log and the status cache), plus a debug log at a path you choose only when CLAIMKEEPER_DEBUG is set.

history.desc: Hooks never change claims, mentions or outputs; the only thing they write is a git-ignored per-session file under .claims/local/.
